def _make_pending_order(event, code, expires=None, **kwargs):
    return Order.objects.create(
        code=code, event=event, email='dummy@dummy.test',
        status=Order.STATUS_PENDING, locale='en',
        datetime=now() - timedelta(days=3),
        expires=expires if expires is not None else now() - timedelta(hours=1),
        total=Decimal('23.00'),
        sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
        **kwargs
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_expires_overdue_pending_order(event):
    o = _make_pending_order(event, 'OVERDUE')
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED
    assert o.all_logentries().filter(action_type='pretix.event.order.expired').exists()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_keeps_order_with_future_deadline(event):
    o = _make_pending_order(event, 'FUTURE', expires=now() + timedelta(days=1))
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_ignores_paid_and_canceled_orders(event):
    paid = _make_pending_order(event, 'PAID', status=Order.STATUS_PAID)
    canceled = _make_pending_order(event, 'CANCELED', status=Order.STATUS_CANCELED)
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    paid.refresh_from_db()
    canceled.refresh_from_db()
    assert paid.status == Order.STATUS_PAID
    assert canceled.status == Order.STATUS_CANCELED


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_respects_disabled_setting(event):
    event.settings.payment_term_expire_automatically = False
    o = _make_pending_order(event, 'NOAUTO')
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_setting_is_per_event(event):
    other = Event.objects.create(
        organizer=event.organizer, name='Other', slug='other', date_from=now(),
        plugins='pretix.plugins.banktransfer'
    )
    other.settings.payment_term_expire_automatically = False
    o_auto = _make_pending_order(event, 'AUTO')
    o_manual = _make_pending_order(other, 'MANUAL')
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o_auto.refresh_from_db()
    o_manual.refresh_from_db()
    assert o_auto.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED
    assert o_manual.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_skips_valid_if_pending(event):
    o = _make_pending_order(event, 'VALIDPENDING', valid_if_pending=True)
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_skips_require_approval(event):
    o = _make_pending_order(event, 'APPROVAL', require_approval=True)
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_skips_orders_with_cancellation_fee(event):
    o = _make_pending_order(event, 'CANCELFEE')
    o.fees.create(fee_type=OrderFee.FEE_TYPE_CANCELLATION, value=Decimal('5.00'))
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_cancels_open_invoice(event):
    o = _make_pending_order(event, 'INVOICE')
    i = generate_invoice(o)
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED
    assert o.invoices.filter(is_cancellation=True, refered=i).exists()
EOF
